Commentary.Commentary: We are back! The umpires are out and are followed by the West Indies players who spread out in the field after a final talk in a close-knit huddle. Zakir Hasan and Mahmudul Hasan Joy are the openers for Bangladesh! Kemar Roach will start the proceedings with the new ball in hand! Away we go!
... FOURTH INNING ...

Taskin Ahmed was the star of the show, orchestrating a sensational dismantling of the West Indies batting lineup, finishing with brilliant figures of 6 wickets. Mehidy Hasan provided strong support, picking up two crucial wickets. West Indies initially showed some resistance before Lunch, with Alick Athanaze and Kavem Hodge stitching together a gritty partnership. However, the game turned dramatically once Taskin returned to the attack, dismissing Hodge. From there, it was a collapse of epic proportions as the hosts lost 7 wickets for just 63 runs, tumbling to a paltry total of 152 in just over 46 overs. Bangladesh now step out with four sessions in hand to chase down a target of 334 runs. While time is comfortably on their side, the key to this challenging pursuit will lie in building strong, consistent partnerships. An exciting final session is on the cards. Stick around as the action will resume in about 20 minutes!

Bangladesh have pulled off a remarkable effort, bundling the hosts out for just 152 runs after their bold decision to declare their innings with a wicket in hand. The gamble seems to have paid off handsomely, giving them a manageable target of 334 runs to chase down now. While the decision to declare might have raised eyebrows initially, it has now set up an intriguing finish. However, the job is far from done - Bangladesh will need to bat brilliantly and show immense resilience to overhaul this challenging target.

Bangladesh made a gutsy call to declare overnight despite a hefty 181-run deficit, and what a statement they’ve made with the ball! Taskin Ahmed was sensational, striking early to remove Mikyle Louis and Keacy Carty, while Shoriful Islam delivered a key blow by dismissing Kraigg Brathwaite. The energy and intent from the bowlers kept the Windies under pressure, though a couple of missed chances mean there’s room for improvement. It’s been a fiery fightback, and the Tigers are keeping this contest alive!
